result.summary: The interface is mostly functional but displays visual polish issues regarding content and text layout.

issues.description: Generic vector illustrations are used as placeholders instead of real food photography.
issues.suggestion: Populate the UI with actual dish photos to improve brand credibility.

issues.description: Restaurant names are truncated in the horizontal scroll section, making them hard to identify.
issues.suggestion: Increase the text container height or implement character limits for titles.

issues.description: The red notification dot on the profile icon is slightly off-center within its gray background.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the badge positioning for a more balanced visual appearance.
